categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the design, development, and sales of low-power wireless computing SoC chips, primarily serving the smart wearable and smart home markets. Key product lines include wireless audio chips, smart wearable chips, smart home chips, and wireless connectivity chips. The chips integrate multiple functional modules such as multi-core CPUs, DSPs, NPUs, image and vision systems, acoustic and audio systems, Wi-Fi/BT baseband and RF, power management, and storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include ultra-low power computing SoC technology integrating multi-core CPU, DSP, NPU, 2.5D GPU, and low-power display controllers. The company develops dual-band low-power Wi-Fi 6 chips with integrated RF front-end modules, advanced Bluetooth protocols including BT5.4 and BT6.0 with proprietary IBRT technology for stable TWS audio transmission, and adaptive ANC audio algorithms. Manufacturing relies on advanced 6nm FinFET process technology, with a fabless model outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include global mainstream Android smartphone brands such as Samsung, OPPO, Xiaomi, Honor, and Vivo; professional audio manufacturers like Harman, Anker Innovations, Edifier, and Soundcore; internet companies including Alibaba, Baidu, ByteDance, and Google; and home appliance manufacturers such as Haier, Hisense, and Gree. The end markets focus on smart wearable devices (TWS earbuds, smartwatches, smart glasses, hearing aids) and smart home devices (smart speakers, smart appliances, whole-house intelligent control terminals).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Xi'an, and Hangzhou. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and the United States. Sales are distributed between domestic (China) and international markets, with significant revenue generated from both regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on chip design and development. It outsources wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and subcontractors, positioning itself in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a chip design and IP provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in low-power wireless SoC platforms, expanding product lines in smart wearables and smart home markets, and enhancing AI computing capabilities with proprietary NPUs and embedded AI co-processors. R&D focuses on advanced Bluetooth and Wi-Fi protocols, integrated audio and acoustic processing, health monitoring sensors, and multi-modal smart device platforms. The company invests heavily in R&D, with over 600 R&D personnel and significant patent filings, aiming to maintain technological leadership and broaden platform capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of SoC chips to brand customers and electronic component distributors. The company employs both direct sales to OEMs and indirect sales through distributors, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control when products are delivered and accepted by customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the low-power wireless computing SoC market for smart wearables and smart home devices in China, competing with international semiconductor firms with larger scale and broader product lines. Its competitive advantages stem from advanced technology, strong brand customer relationships, and comprehensive platform solutions. The company faces competition from global chip manufacturers but has established a strong foothold through innovation and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.26 billion, representing a 49.94% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 460 million, a 272.47% increase from the previous year. The company maintains a strong cash position with over RMB 3.8 billion in cash and equivalents and continues to invest heavily in R&D, accounting for nearly 19% of revenue. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and R&D investment, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its ultra-low power consumption, high integration, and advanced wireless connectivity technologies as key differentiators. Its SoC chips integrate multi-core processing, AI acceleration, advanced audio processing, and dual-band Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity, delivering superior performance and user experience for smart wearables and smart home devices. The company’s proprietary technologies such as IBRT for Bluetooth and adaptive ANC algorithms enhance product stability and audio quality, creating strong competitive barriers and customer loyalty.
